        "A"

        "Integrity": "yes",

        "I",
        "A"

        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [

      ],
      "Exit Lines": [
        169

      "Concept Name": "Receive link handshake",

      "Information": "The receive-side valid and ready handshake determines whether incoming words are accepted. The receive transfer depends on the peer offering valid data and the unit exposing capacity.",

        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",

      "Rubric": {
